title: Towards a science of human stories: using sentiment analysis and emotional arcs to understand the building blocks of complex social systems
reasoning: The dissertation focuses on the development and benchmarking of sentiment analysis tools and their application to measuring the emotional arcs of stories. While it references religious categories in folklore and studies social discourse on Twitter (e.g., #BlackLivesMatter), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as defined in the prompt.
